title: AI stock quote line: two agents sharing one reusable skill with different settings
alias: reusable skill for voice AI agents
summary: A stock quote demo built to show a skill written once and loaded by two agents with different parameters. The skill holds the provider, keeps the API key out of the SWML, and scopes each agent by a watchlist.
scenario: A caller asks what a ticker is trading at; a public line answers any symbol and an employee line answers only the company's
